name: DPC
fix_description: In func_283D (getClaimQuota), the formula accumulates oldClaimQuota without resetting it after each claim. Fix: clear oldClaimQuota after it is added to the new quota, so repeated claims cannot grow the quota indefinitely.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a short, linear sequence of standard token swaps, liquidity add/stake, time warp, repeated claims, and final swap-out with no flash loan, reentrancy, or complex cross-protocol logic. It appears to exploit obvious reward/airdrop accounting flaws in a single protocol, which a competent auditor could reproduce quickly after reading the staking and airdrop functions.
